name: FinaShare
description:
Split expenses with friends - fast, simple, and fair.

FinaShare makes it easy to manage shared expenses with friends, roommates, travel companions, or groups - on a trip, eating out, or splitting everyday costs.

- Scan receipts using OCR & AI and effortlessly split even large, complex bills with many items between multiple people
- Split expenses in different ways: equally, by quantity, percentage, or individual items
- Manage expenses in multiple currencies
- Keep everything organized with customizable groups and user profiles

Built for speed and smooth performance, with full NativeAOT compilation and extensive customization options.
author: Mariusz Baranski
